latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

bill.title: Annual Public Housing Inspections Accountability Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill requires HUD and the Comptroller General to report to Congress within one year on how many HUD public housing inspections in a year were incomplete. It must also state how many inspectors are needed to ensure all required inspections can be completed annually.

impact.summary: The bill directs the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development and the Comptroller General to study and report how many HUD public housing inspections are incomplete in a year. It affects HUD, the GAO, local public housing authorities, inspection staff, and HUD public housing residents.
